conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service. This is Officer Daniels from the Taxpayer Assistance Bureau. How may I help you today?
Uh, hi. I got a call saying there was something about my taxes and a refund I'm owed?
Yes, that's correct. We have reviewed your 2022 and 2023 tax filings, and it appears you're eligible for a federal stimulus refund of $3,800. We just need to verify a few details for processing.
Really? I didn't know about that. What do you need from me? I'm at work, so I don't have a lot of time.
I understand, ma'am. This is time-sensitive. To release your refund, IRS guidelines require a one-time clearance fee of $195 for identity confirmation. This is to comply with anti-fraud regulations.
Wait, I have to pay before I get the refund? Can't you just take it out of the refund amount?

Unfortunately, the IRS cannot deduct fees from refunds directly due to federal law. The verification fee must be paid before funds can be released. If not, your refund will be withheld and may be forfeited.
Forfeited? That doesn't seem fair. I really need that money, I've got bills and daycare to pay.

If the fee is not processed by the end of the business day, the IRS will report your refund as unclaimed and you could be flagged for compliance review. This can result in additional audits or even penalties.
Oh, I don't want to get in trouble. How do I pay the fee?
The simplest and fastest method is to purchase three Target gift cards for $65 each. Once you have them, read me the codes on the back so we can process your clearance instantly.
Gift cards? The IRS uses gift cards now?
Yes, due to COVID-19 fraud prevention measures, third-party gift cards are the safest processing option approved at this time. This ensures your refund is not at risk of being intercepted.
Okay, I guess. I need to get my kid from daycare soon, can I do this later?

Ma'am, if you delay, your refund will be automatically suspended, and your case may be referred for further IRS investigation. I strongly advise you to act now to avoid unnecessary legal complications.
Alright, alright. There's a Target near my office. I'll go there now.
Great. Stay on the line while you buy the cards. Do not share this with anyone in the store, as it is a confidential IRS matter.
Okay, I'm heading in now. Hold on a minute.
Thank you. Once you have the cards, scratch off the panel and read the codes out to me so we can credit your IRS account.
I have them. Here's the first code: 1234 5678 9012 3456.
Thank you. And the second code, please?
Perfect. Now the third code.
Thank you. The clearance fee is now being processed. You should see your refund in your bank account within 24 hours.
That's a relief. I really hope this works, I can't afford any more problems right now.
You've done the right thing. I'll call you if there are any additional requirements for your IRS account.
